name: Anima Anime
author: various
description: Anima (Cosmos) anime checkpoints: the official models and the fast cards. Anima Base v1.0 (the widest range of styles), the official Anima Turbo v1.1 (10 steps, about 6 s) and the official Anima-2.9B v1 preview, plus VXP Anima Turbo, the two RDBT distills and Diving v8 (flat TV-anime cel shading). Since 2.0.0 the other cards are in Anima Large (the 2.9B and 3.8B fine-tunes), Anima Anime Mixes (clean, bright mixes) and Anima Art & Styles (soft, 2.5D and painterly looks). Prompt with Danbooru tags. All Anima cards share the Qwen 0.6B text encoder and Qwen-Image VAE.

presets.name: VXP Anima Turbo V1
presets.description:
Fast anime pictures with one strong, consistent style: clean linework, rich colour and solid faces. Built to finish in 12-15 steps, about 12 seconds for a 1 MP picture on a 12 GB card.

Prompt with Danbooru tags, plain sentences, or both. For a known character, look up its exact tag on animadex.net first. Keep CFG around 3-4; higher looks forced.

The author forbids re-uploading the model to PixAI.

Model format: bf16, not quantized.

presets.name: RDBT Anima v2.3 (16-step)
presets.tagline: Newer RDBT: painterly, moody, no default style
presets.description:
Painterly, moody anime in 16 steps, about 6 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card. Next to the RDBT b1 card it comes out softer, more painterly and darker-lit.

This model has no built-in style on purpose, so name one (an @artist tag or a style in words) or the look will wander. No quality tags needed.

This is the newest of the distilled RDBT versions and the last one: the author has stopped updating them. The author does not allow sharing merges of this model.

Model format: fp16, not quantized.

presets.name: Anima-2.9B v1 (preview)
presets.description:
A bigger Anima, grown from 28 to 40 layers and trained on 1.7 million more anime pictures, with characters and series up to July 2026. In our test it gave the most different pictures of the Anima cards, with its own compositions and a warm, saturated palette.

It needs detailed prompts: name the series after every character, describe the background, and keep the year tag the card adds. A one-sentence prompt left most of the frame empty in our test.

About 24 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card. An early preview, by the author's own account.

Licence: CircleStone Labs Non-Commercial License (derivative model).

Model format: bf16, not quantized.

presets.name: Anima Turbo v1.1 (official)
presets.tagline: The official fast Anima: 10 steps, about 6 seconds
presets.description:
The official fast Anima from the makers of the base model, and the fastest Anima card: about 6 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card, in 10 steps.

Expect crisp lines, strong contrast and a confident default style. The authors say the speed trades some variety for stability, and recommend starting here and iterating on prompts quickly.

Artist tags work: start them with @.

Licence (Civitai): image use and on-site generation allowed; derivatives allowed.

Model format: bf16, not quantized.
